schema.description: Configured-budget evaluation for a concrete target and selector, not runtime admission, model eligibility, or agent-run preflight. AVAILABLE can mean that no configured policy applies; inspect applicable_policy_count and the exact selector echo. Configured caps are evaluated_limits[].value.amount, accrued usage is evaluated_limits[].used, and remaining budget is effective_limits[].remaining. Approved one-period grants raise headroom without changing the configured cap. Units are never combined or converted. Non-admin evaluation omits shared budgets from applicable_policy_count, evaluated_limits, and effective_limits; decision can be BLOCKED by a shared budget even when the target's own limits show remaining headroom. decision_causes explains every non-AVAILABLE decision, including one caused by a budget that is not listed.

target.description: Normalized concrete ORGANIZATION, USER, or AGENT evaluated. USER targets contain the canonical user_id, not the supplied alias ID or email. Included even when no configured policies apply.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; valid only when type is USER. A USER target requires user_id, email, or both.

email.description: Email address of the user, including a known alias email; valid only when type is USER. Matching is case-insensitive and resolves to the canonical user_id. When user_id is also supplied, both must identify the same user. Email is never part of the stored limit key. Responses include the user's directory email when one is available.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent ID; required only when type is AGENT.

usage_selector.description: Exact evaluated selector, including case and padding of client_id; never normalized.

client_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive spend-client ID, such as glean or an external gateway spend-client ID. Case and leading or trailing padding are preserved exactly; this is not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application, prefixed, or normalized. Empty and whitespace-only IDs (including Unicode whitespace), synthetic UI aggregation IDs, and control characters are invalid. Unknown IDs are valid and can have no applicable configured policies.

applicable_policy_count.description: Number of applicable configured policies returned in evaluated_limits, including UNLIMITED policies. Zero explicitly means no returned policy matched, not an unlimited configured rule. Non-admin evaluation excludes shared budgets. Included even when zero.

decision.description: Overall configured-budget status across all applicable limits, not runtime admission. On non-admin evaluation this includes shared budgets that are not returned: BLOCKED with remaining effective_limits headroom means a shared budget is exhausted. Shared soft limits never cause WARNING there. decision_causes explains why decision is not AVAILABLE.

x-enumDescriptions.AVAILABLE: Usage is within all applicable configured limits.
x-enumDescriptions.WARNING: Usage reached or exceeded a configured soft limit.
x-enumDescriptions.BLOCKED: Usage reached or exceeded a configured hard limit; this is not a runtime admission decision.

items.title: PlatformUsageDecisionCause

decision_causes.description: Categories of limit that make decision WARNING or BLOCKED, BLOCKED causes first. Empty exactly when decision is AVAILABLE. Each distinct decision, budget_scope, and source_type appears once. A SHARED cause with decision BLOCKED means usage is unavailable even when effective_limits shows remaining headroom. Causes never include amounts, usage, thresholds, or pool identities. Non-admin evaluation reports SHARED causes only when they are BLOCKED.

effective_limits.description: Tightest remaining budget per finite unit, ordered USD then CREDITS. remaining is headroom after accrued usage and approved one-period grants, not a configured cap. Units are never combined or converted. When no finite policy applies, contains a single UNLIMITED entry without remaining, unit, or enforcement, including when applicable_policy_count is zero. Covers only returned evaluated_limits, so non-admin headroom excludes shared budgets. This configured-budget result is not a runtime admission guarantee.

mode.title: PlatformAmountMode

amount.description: Plain non-negative decimal amount with at most six fractional digits; required when mode is FINITE and forbidden when mode is UNLIMITED. Limits use single-precision (float32) storage: inputs are rounded to that precision, and responses report the stored value rounded to six fractional digits. For example, 100.10 can be returned as 100.099998. This storage limitation does not reduce the precision of measured usage counters.

unit.description: Unit for the selected spend domain; must match its billing denomination. Aggregate agent limits use the workspace plan denomination.
